flows.step:law-play-fold: DEAD BY READING, ONE RACE UNPROVEN (2026-11-25) — the fold is raised only where an awaiting handoff resolves with the law's card landing and NO claim in the frame; the direct commit places its claim before the emit (`claimLawPlayOutcome`), and the staged door begins no awaiting handoff. flows.surface:colony-controller: FAILURE PATH (re-read 2026-11-24) — the scope waits only in its two bounded nets: the entry's («entered, and nothing ever arrived», `COLONY_BONUS_ENTRY_WAIT_MS`) and the sequence's («another cycle is owed and nothing of it has arrived», `COLONY_BONUS_CYCLE_WAIT_MS`). The remote colony bonus itself IS walked — `console-colony-remote-bonus` (three tests) and `console-pluto-two-colony-sequence` on every whole suite, the `miranda-remote-bonus` / `pluto-settlements-*` tables under the monkey — and arms neither: the evidence is already there when the viewer walks in, and the next cycle rides the answer of the one before. To walk: the fault pass with the colony's answer HELD between the entry and its first evidence, or between two cycles.

flows.surface:draft-tray: DEAD BY READING (2026-11-25) — the tray mounts only in Phase.INITIALDRAFTING (`draftController.draftTrayMounted`), and no creation path of the product can ask for that phase (the creator sends `initialDraft: false` — `buildCreateGamePayload`; campaigns and rematches copy it; the server's default is false). Its rise half contradicts itself: armed only by a RESEARCH buy, when the tray has already unmounted — and the task host's `riseExtras` with it. Leaves with its code: the component, `draftTrayMounted` and its two pad/bar terms, `riseExtras`, the INITIALDRAFTING terms of `isDraftPick` / `DRAFT_PHASES`, the `.con-drafttray*` rules.
flows.surface:gamepad-focus-ring: THE DOM FOCUS ENGINE's REFUSAL SHAKE — its scope waits only when a press is refused on a PAGE-level DOM scope (the loading curtain, a screen before the console takes the pad: `focusEngine.deny`); a game of the pilot stands on console-owned scopes (the engine draws nothing there) from its first press to the final scoring. Walked by the monkey's passes (the kernel's ledger holds it walked) and by the focus engine's unit specs — not a situation of the game.

flows.surface:played-controller: DEAD BY READING (2026-11-25) — the played hero's `overlay` host: every entry point of a play resolves to the `workspace` host (a prelude of the start, a deck pick, the staged ritual — hard-coded; the hand's play — the hand frame is always descended and «Разыграно» cannot stand open under a composer; the law's play — the card-actions frame is mounted and the bill is set). submit.presenting → abandoned: FAILURE PATH — a presentation that never ends: the submit's own bound over the story its answer set off (120 s). The fault pass breaks the WIRE (7 of 8 moves); this one needs a story that hangs. To walk: the synthetic-layout pass with a flight that never lands.
submit.presenting → failed: FAILURE PATH — an answer received whose body or presenter throws (`gameTransport` — `response.json()` / the presenter outside a gate); only a corrupt response makes it.
submit.sending → silent: FAILURE PATH — no response headers for 60 s (`SUBMIT_NO_RESPONSE_MS`), a stalled server or proxy; the weather's faults answer sooner.

claim.live/arrival: timed → closed: RARE — a GATED retain (the next card outcome of one flow) while the previous batch is still arriving. To walk: a card action whose result draws, retained for a second draw before the first has landed.
claim.live/beat: over → pending: RARE — the execution beat re-armed after it was over: a retained claim's NEXT commit while it still awaits. To walk: a two-commit flow on one claim (a repeat of an action inside one workspace).
claim.live/host: orphaned → bound: A CLAIM's HOST FRAME ENDING AND A FRAME OF THE SAME WORKSPACE STANDING AGAIN INSIDE THE 1.5 s GRACE (`CLAIM_HOST_GONE_GRACE_MS`): a park or a yield keeps the frame's scope (no orphan), so only a frame CLOSED under a live claim and re-entered at once makes it — a re-entry a player's pace (and the pilot's, ≥150 ms a press and a look between) makes by chance only. The move is the claim machine's own (its explorer walks every edge — `flowMachines`), and the monkey's passes walk it in the page.
claim.live/stage: awaiting → held: FAILURE PATH (a watchdog) — 20 s in `awaiting` with nothing presenting while the claim still serves: a server slower than twenty seconds, or an embed that never says it presents.
claim.live/stage: held → awaiting: FAILURE PATH, second half — `held` is reached only by the claim's SAFETY (8 walks of the broken wire); leaving it by a RETAIN needs the flow to go on after that. To walk: a silent server, then a retained outcome.
claim.live/stage: held → presenting: FAILURE PATH, second half — the artifact arriving AFTER the claim's safety put it in `held`: a late answer behind a broken wire. To walk: the fault pass with the answer released after the safety.
claim.live/stage: presentingOwed → awaiting: RARE — a release REFUSED while the claim presents (2 walks reach `presentingOwed`), then the same claim retained for the next outcome before the bound re-asks.

announce.late → acknowledged: RARE — an announce past its bound (9 walks reach `late`) that the player then acknowledges; the walks move on or end first. To walk: stand on an announced question past the bound, then press.
announce.late → presented: FAILURE PATH — a first presentation past its bound: the plate's door (`mandatory-gate/overdue`, a defect the gate files — #181 was one). A whole game of the pilot walks it only by a defect.
announce.pending → late: FAILURE PATH — a first presentation past its bound: the plate's door (`mandatory-gate/overdue`, a defect the gate files — #181 was one). A whole game of the pilot walks it only by a defect.
